Sir,

therein.

page_data.en:
November 5 37.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No.3386 dated 14th October, 1937, and
in reply to inform you that apart from the fact that
L.V. Kanoonikoff was fined $35 by the old French Mixed
Court on 13-10-26 for being drunk and disorderly in a
public establishment, there is nothing in Municipal
Police records against this individual. A copy of
report is attached.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Acting Consul-General,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Date .... November 4, 1937

Subject .... Communication dated 14-10-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning L.V. Kanoonikoff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Gavan [signature]

Leonid Vassilievich KANOONIKOFF, Russian, was born
on April 4, 1888 in Samara Province, Russia. He is reported to
have arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok via Harbin in 1924
and to have since been residing in this city. In Shanghai he
worked as a stage manager and actor until 1925, after which he
was employed for various periods as a draughtsman or supervi-
sor with the following firms:-

1. C.H. Gonda    From 1-4-25 to 15-4-26
   4 Ezra Road

2. Iedreux, Minutti & Co.,    From May, 1926 to 30-4-28
   668 Szechuen Road

3. French Tramway Company    From 25-5-28 to 1-10-28

4. A. Corrit.    From 11-10-28 to 30-4-29
   278 Kiangsi Road

5. The Texas Company (China), From May, 1929 to January, 1933
   12 The Bund

6. Graham & Painter, Ltd }    From February, 1929 to Novem-
   668 Szechuen Road       } ber, 1936 and from March to
                             September, 1937.

He is in possession of good testimonials from
these firms.

Kanoonikoff is registered with the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau, the Council of United Russian Organi-
zation (SORO) and the Russian Emigrants' Committee.

In Shanghai he is generally known under the name
L.V. LEONIDOFF. All testimonials referred to above were issued
in this name. In 1933 he registered with the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee under the name L.V. Leonidoff. It appears that
that the latter organization is not aware that this is an alias

Leonid Vassilievich KANOONIKOFF，俄国人，1888 年 4 月 4 日出生于俄罗斯萨马拉省。据报他于 1924 年从符拉迪沃斯托克经哈尔滨抵达上海，并自此居住于本市。在上海，他从事舞台监督和演员工作直至 1925 年，此后曾在以下公司断续受雇担任绘图员或监工：-

1. C.H. Gonda    从 1925 年 4 月 1 日至 1926 年 4 月 15 日
   爱多亚路 4 号

2. Iedreux, Minutti & Co.,    从 1926 年 5 月至 1928 年 4 月 30 日
   四川路 668 号

3. 法国电车公司    从 1928 年 5 月 25 日至 1928 年 10 月 1 日

4. A. Corrit.    从 1928 年 10 月 11 日至 1929 年 4 月 30 日
   江西路 278 号

5. 德士古石油公司（中国）， 从 1929 年 5 月至 1933 年 1 月
   外滩 12 号

6. Graham & Painter, Ltd }    从 1929 年 2 月至 1936 年 11
   四川路 668 号       } 月，以及从 1937 年 3 月至
                             9 月。

他持有上述公司出具的良好推荐信。

Kanoonikoff 已在上海市政府警察局、全俄侨民组织联合会（SORO）及俄侨委员会登记注册。

在上海，他通常以 L.V. LEONIDOFF 之名为人所知。上述所有推荐信均以此名签发。1933 年，他以 L.V. Leonidoff 之名在俄侨委员会登记。看来该组织并不知晓这是 Kanoonikoff 的别名

Date ____ 19

Subject ____

-2-

Made by ____ Forwarded by ____

of Kanoonikoff.
Asked to explain the reasons for using an assumed name Kanoonikoff stated that leonidoff was his stage name in 1924-25 and that under this name he was introduced to his first employer, Mr. Gonda, in 1925. Since that time Leonidoff has been his "business name".
According to his own statement, Kanonnikoff is married, but since 1923 has not heard from his wife. On being informed that a certain Mrs. V.G. Kanunnikoff has been conducting for the past several years an establishment known as the "Salon des Modes" at No 30 Bromley Road, Tientsin, he stated that he had no knowledge about this and that the lady may be his wife, as the name and initials correspond to those of his wife. His attitude towards this matter seemed to be rather strange, and it is possible, therefore, that his family affairs may have some connection with his living under an assumed name.
Kanoonikoff resides at 670 Avenue Joffre.
While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an undesirable character, except for the fact that on 13-10-26 he was fined $ 35 by the old French Mixed Court for being drunk and disorderly in a public establishment and was ordered to pay $ 130 to complainant as a compensation for damaged property. He was charged under the name L.V. Leonidoff.

A. Prokopiew
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

当被要求解释使用假名的原因时，Kanoonikoff 称 Leonidoff 是他在 1924-25 年间的艺名，且 1925 年他是以此名被介绍给其第一位雇主 Gonda 先生的。自那时起，Leonidoff 一直是他的“商用名”。
据其自称，Kanonnikoff 已婚，但自 1923 年以来未收到妻子的音讯。当被告知一位名为 V.G. Kanunnikoff 的女士过去几年一直在天津布罗姆利路 30 号经营一家名为“时尚沙龙”（Salon des Modes）的场所时，他表示对此一无所知，并称该女士可能是其妻子，因为姓名和首字母与其妻子相符。他对此事的态度显得颇为奇怪，因此，其家庭事务可能与他使用假名生活有关。
Kanoonikoff 居住在霞飞路 670 号。
在上海期间，除 1926 年 10 月 13 日因在公共场所醉酒滋事被旧法租界会审公廨罚款 35 美元，并被责令向投诉人支付 130 美元作为财产损坏赔偿外，他并未因任何不良行为引起工部局警务处的注意。当时他被指控时使用的名字是 L.V. Leonidoff。

A. Prokopiew
侦探警长

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3316.                                SHANGHAI,    14 October    1937 .

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Leonid Vassilievitch
KANOONIKOFF has applied to this Consulate General for a visa for
admission into the Netherlands Indies.

    Mr. Kanoonikoff was born at Samara (Russia) on April 12, 1888,
and has applied for a Chinese passport with the Bureau of Public
Safety at Shanghai.

    He stated that he has been in Shanghai for the last 14 years,
during which time he has worked with several firms here as an
engineer, viz. 5 years with the Texas Oil Company, with the
French Tramways and lately with Messrs. Painter & Graham.

    He intends to visit his relations in the Netherlands Indies,
who will pay for his passage and expenses during his stay there.

    He resides at 670 Avenue Joffre.

    I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

                                            I have the honour to be,

                                                        Sir,

                                            Your obedient servant,

（签名）
                                            Acting Consul-General.

第 3316 号。                                上海，    1937 年 10 月 14 日    。

先生：

    谨此告知，Leonid Vassilievitch
KANOONIKOFF 先生已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

    Kanoonikoff 先生于 1888 年 4 月 12 日出生于萨马拉（俄罗斯），
并向上海公共安全局申请了中国护照。

    他声称过去 14 年一直居住在上海，
在此期间，他曾在此地多家公司担任工程师，即：在德士古石油公司工作 5 年，
在法国电车公司工作，最近则在 Painter & Graham 先生公司工作。

    他打算前往荷属东印度探望亲属，
其亲属将支付他的旅费及在当地停留期间的费用。

    他居住在霞飞路 670 号。

    如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，
本人将不胜感激。

                                            谨致

                                                        敬礼，
